payload.title: [Figs. 11-12] LMR v2.1 vs Büntgen et al ensemble
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook compares the LMR v2.1 dataset with the ensemble from Büntgen et al., 2021, focusing on Northern Hemisphere summer temperatures. It quantifies the distance between these datasets and reproduces figures 11 and 12 from the study. The notebook utilizes various scientific libraries to load, process, and visualize the data, including spectral analysis and probability estimation. The outputs include visualizations of temperature reconstructions and statistical analyses.
goals: Quantify the distance between LMR v2.1 and Büntgen et al. ensemble.
Reproduce figures 11 and 12 from the study.
Analyze Northern Hemisphere summer temperature reconstructions.
